method.accession_signature: median pLDDT >= 90 and median lDDT < 0.4 across all ledger rows for accession
method.chain_inconsistency: at least two >=30-row chains for the same accession/entry with median pLDDT >=90 and median lDDT gap >=0.4
method.chain_signature: at least 30 rows, median pLDDT >= 90, median lDDT < 0.4 for one entry/chain
method.note: The 0.4 gap is a transparent audit-screen threshold; flagged rows are candidates, not proof of mapping error.
